package.name: xeno_can
package.description:
This package implements a high-level interface to the functionalities of the Xeno wheelchair (by Otto Bock) accessible through the CAN bus:
- Sending motor commands via a virtual joystick - Enable/disable joystick control by the user - Lights control: Light, hazard lights, and left and right indicators - Catches joystick data
Disclaimer: Information on the CAN protocol used by the wheelchair was provided to us under a non-disclosure agreement. You are not allowed to distribute any parts of this package without written permission.
package.author: Jose Alvarez-Ruiz
